name: chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 7

function.text: CHD7 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD7. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cognition.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to CHARGE syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
